note: From the OpenStreetMap export (main API, 13 October 2026; tools/osm-to-kit.mjs) and the view from above (docs/reference/aerial/belle-vue.jpg), at real scale across the line like the tracks. Positive v is east-north-east; the line runs north-north-west towards Manchester. Two side platforms of about 97 m, 1.68 m outside the Marple line's two tracks; the halt's is the real platform 2 on the west side, for trains towards Manchester. Hyde Road (the A57) crosses over the line on a skewed bridge just north of the platforms (drawn square across the line). There is no footbridge: passengers cross on Hyde Road, reached by a long path from each platform up the side of the line to the road by the bridge (the way across), the west one beside Glencastle Road's footpath, the east one coming out by the Hyde Road/Belle Vue Station bus stop; drawn as a ramp behind each platform up to the bridge. The platforms take a four-car train as they are; trains stop at the station's point, and the extensions, 25 m at each end, let a six-car one stand (a game choice: where they'd go is open ground in the view from above). The bus stop is Hyde Road/Belle Vue Station (stop A), on Hyde Road east of the bridge. No photographs: the shelters, lamps and boards are the usual Northern ones from memory, the low walls along the line are from memory, the station is unstaffed with no booking office (from memory), and the lifts and canopy are the game's. Real scale (13 October 2026): everything across the line (v, outlines, rails, widths across) divided by 1.25 from the 1.25 times real it was drawn at, so the kit stands on its real footprint and lines up with the real buildings round it.
